envelope: Proposed explicit versioned authenticated immutable cohort envelope containing two individually typed per-Node runtime records, plan/prior-record digest, exact scope, owner and proof digests; no overwrite or unsigned mirror authority

typedImageFields.name: runtimeDockerImageId
typedImageFields.meaning: Actual owned Docker image inspect Id and container inspect Image; daemon-local content identity, often config digest, NEVER treated as repository manifest/index, archive, binary or source hash

typedImageFields.name: runtimeRepositoryReferenceAndDigest
typedImageFields.meaning: Real immutable repository reference plus RepoDigest and media type when present; resolve index to exact OS/architecture platform manifest; no tag-only authority

typedImageFields.name: runtimePlatformManifestDigest
typedImageFields.meaning: Selected platform manifest bytes hash from authenticated publication, distinct from index digest and local image Id

typedImageFields.name: runtimeConfigDigest
typedImageFields.meaning: Published image config bytes hash, matched to actual Engine image/config identity with a verified format-specific mapping, not guessed by equal-looking strings

typedImageFields.name: runtimeRootFSDiffIDs
typedImageFields.meaning: Ordered uncompressed RootFS diffIDs from actual inspect and published config; compressed layer blob digests are separately verified publication metadata and are not interchangeable

typedImageFields.name: runtimeImageArchiveSHA256
typedImageFields.meaning: Exact transferred archive bytes hash if offline packaging; archive hash does not identify the executable or replace loaded-image/layer/config validation

typedImageFields.name: runtimeExecutableSHA256
typedImageFields.meaning: Exact published inv-node executable bytes; must equal signed actual live-process executable hash from reviewed M2

typedImageFields.name: runtimeSourceGitSHA
typedImageFields.meaning: Full actual published P0 Git source commit linked to executable/image by verified reproducible build/CI provenance; never inferred from a label, tag or this document SHA

typedImageFields.name: preservedPermitImageDigest
typedImageFields.meaning: Exact old Cmd --image string accepted by Go config.Image for signed workload launch ImageDigest; unchanged even though runtimeDockerImageId changes

repositoryOrOfflineUnion.repository: Verified immutable repository/index/manifest/config/layer/platform chain and actual loaded-image mapping
repositoryOrOfflineUnion.offline: Explicit authenticated absence of RepoDigest plus real archive SHA256, config/layer/platform manifest/build provenance and actual loaded-image mapping; never synthesize RepoDigest from image Id
